g.text: No conventional test with broad validation

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: * PSA is in seminal plasma; not wholly semen-exclusive [Gam20, Sak20].

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: ** RSID-Saliva detects salivary α-amylase antigen; cautioned against as confirmatory [Str23b].

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Raman and FTIR spectroscopy have also been investigated to classify stains from molecular spectra [Sij21].
